setlist.title: It Must Have Been The Roses

liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **To Lay Me Down** (2 reviews): Bob tries one more chorus as Jerry ends it; a band spat follows, and Brent shouts that everyone makes mistakes; Vocals, harmonies and playing are tight, shown in a beautiful To Lay Me Down [14][22]
- **Cassidy** (2 reviews): A hot Cassidy follows right after the on-stage tiff; Cassidy is as hot as any electric version, with great jamming that suits acoustic instruments [14][22]
- **Dark Hollow** (1 review): The opening Dark Hollow is a little shaky [22]
- **Comes A Time** (1 review): Comes A Time into Lost Sailor and Saint features exquisitely understated Jerry solos [19]

## The recordings

- **gd1980-10-02.sbd.aud.miller.114364.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 32 songs; 197 min; rated 3.25/5 by 4 [1]
- **gd80-10-02.nak300.vernon.16154.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 31 songs; 195 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [2]
- **gd1980-10-02.nak700.ellner.mandell.gmb.89111.sbeok.flac16**: source not stated; 31 songs; 200 min; rated 4.5/5 by 2 [3]
- **gd1980-10-02.141014.pt.akg.cm.miller.flac1644**: source not stated; 13 songs; 95 min [4]
- **gd1980-10-02.140819.s2ps3p.akg24.miller.flac2496**: source not stated; 13 songs; 95 min [5]
- **gd80-10-02.set3-sbd.jerugim.2204.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 11 songs; 84 min; rated 4.33/5 by 3 [6]. Said about its sound: The third-set soundboard sounds great and better than the other version on archive.org [16]
- **gd80-10-02.acoustic-sbd.wiley.8039.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 11 songs; 65 min; rated 4.82/5 by 11 [8]

## Around the show

- Jerry has his new guitar dialed in, with watery, delicate tone throughout the night [19]
- Having both To Lay Me Down and Bird Song in one acoustic set makes this show stand out [13]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1980-10-02.sbd.aud.miller.114364.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: Set 1: SBD -> Reel Master -> Cassette -> Dat -> CD (shnid=8039) Set 2: Nakamichi 700 -> Cassette Master -> Reel -> Dat -> CD (shnid=89111) Set 3: SBD ->… [1]. Also: This sbd/aud source is tracked by set rather than by disc and has had pitch correction applied [1]
- **gd80-10-02.nak300.vernon.16154.sbeok.shnf**: source: Audience Recording: Nak300 > Sony TC-152 [2]. Also: This audience tape completes the full show, after the earlier acoustic-set board and the second-set board releases [21]
- **gd1980-10-02.nak700.ellner.mandell.gmb.89111.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Ron Ellner; transferred by Peter Mandell & Bill Koucky; source: Master Cassette > Nakamichi 700's > Sony TC D-5 > Teac Reel > PC > EAC > TLH > FLAC [3]. Also: Ron Ellner recorded and archived this tape; the master cassettes were stolen; Taper position was FOB, either on the floor or in the first row of the balcony; The text file says the encore is missing, but it is included as d1t10 [3]
- **gd1980-10-02.141014.pt.akg.cm.miller.flac1644**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: AKG Mics (m/s) > Cassette Master (Sony TC-D5M/Maxell UD-XLII/Dolby B) [4]
- **gd1980-10-02.140819.s2ps3p.akg24.miller.flac2496**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: AKG Mics (m/s) > Cassette Master (Sony TC-D5M/TDK MA-R90/Dolby B) [5]
- **gd80-10-02.set3-sbd.jerugim.2204.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [6]
- **gd80-10-02.acoustic-sbd.wiley.8039.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [8]. Also: The upload wrongly includes Wharf Rat and Heaven Help the Fool tracks, which should be left out to get the real set; The Wharf Rat on the acoustic soundboard is thought to come from Boston Garden, 05-07-77, between The Wheel and Around and Around; The Heaven Help the Fool on the acoustic upload is believed to come from the 10-13-80 Warfield show [13][17][20]
